document: Universal Mobile Control — Audited Batch Chronology

source_of_truth.rule: Current source determines implementation facts; README determines historical test claims. Conflicts are retained and marked RETEST_REQUIRED.

project.name: Universal Mobile Control
project.historical_screen_reference: 1080x2400; must be rediscovered on each fresh scan

events: Accessibility-based phone controller selected.
Termux/MCP to local HTTP bridge to AccessibilityService architecture defined.
Observation designed around Accessibility UI tree, screenshot and ML Kit OCR.
Tap, swipe, Back and text entry planned.
MainActivity and VisionAccessibilityService implemented.
Local bridge binds to 127.0.0.1:8765.
UI nodes expose text, description, bounds and state.
Latin and Devanagari OCR implemented.
UniversalMobileControl-debug.apk produced.
Version recorded as 0.1.0 / Vision Engine MVP.
Gradle 8.13 under Termux recorded in project history.
chronology.limitation: Exact APK hash and exact installed revision were not recorded.

events: Historical screen/UI observation used 1080x2400.
Accessibility and OCR data were used to locate controls.
chronology.correction: 1080x2400 is historical evidence, not a fixed device constant.

events: Current source exposes /health, /screen, /scan, /action/start, /action/stop, /action/status, /tap, /swipe, /back and /type.
/home is not implemented.
/screen returns cached latestJson.
/scan starts asynchronous scanning and Action Mode.
HTTP response is 200 even when application JSON status is error.
Editable 'Ask anything' node was found around 313,1865 to 1049,1957.
Tap around 680,1910 was dispatched.
Keyboard/focus change was not independently confirmed.
chronology.correction: Dispatch acceptance is not a successful tap proof.

events: Old request used start_x/start_y/end_x/end_y and failed because x1 was missing.
Current source expects x1,y1,x2,y2 and optional duration.
Back was user-confirmed working.
/home historically returned unknown endpoint.
A coordinate tap near Android navigation was not treated as proof of a /home API.
tapAt and swipeFromTo use GestureResultCallback.
CountDownLatch and AtomicReference distinguish completed, cancelled and timeout outcomes.
Tap waits 3 seconds; swipe waits 6 seconds.
chronology.audit_note: A callback timeout proves only that completion/cancellation was not observed within the wait window; it does not alone prove that no physical gesture occurred.

events: HandlerThread UMC-GestureCallbacks is created in onServiceConnected.
gestureCallbackHandler is passed to dispatchGesture.
The thread is quit in onDestroy.
canPerformGestures=true.
canRetrieveWindowContent=true.
canTakeScreenshot=true.
Interactive-window, view-id and include-not-important-views flags enabled.
chronology.correction: Configuration does not by itself prove callback delivery or target UI change.

events: Recorded tap retest returned tap callback timeout.
Recorded swipe retest returned swipe callback timeout.
possible_causes: Current APK may not have been installed/restarted.
Accessibility service may still be running an older revision.
Gesture callback delivery may still be failing.
Disable/re-enable service cycle may be required.

events: README records Android Home to app drawer to native YouTube to search to Tum Hi Ho to ad Skip to playback verification.
Final state reportedly showed song title, T-Series channel, lyrics, Pause control and approximately 4–5 seconds elapsed of a 4:27 video.
chronology.correction: Retain as historical end-to-end evidence, but do not use it as proof of the currently installed revision until exact APK/service provenance is established and the flow is retested.

audit_findings.finding: Tap/swipe callback completion is not currently proven in the latest recorded runtime tests.
audit_findings.correction: Do not mark PASS from HTTP 200 or dispatch acceptance. Require callback completion/cancellation plus fresh UI verification.

audit_findings.finding: README contains a later native YouTube PASS while the current source can still return gesture callback timeout.
audit_findings.correction: Treat the YouTube PASS as historical and mark current-build regression status RETEST_REQUIRED.

audit_findings.finding: Action Mode can initiate periodic scans while another screenshot/OCR operation may still be active.
tapAt/swipeFromTo call startActionMode before dispatching the gesture, which can trigger a scan before the action.
audit_findings.correction: Separate action dispatch from verification refresh; action first, then fresh verification scan.

audit_findings.finding: New Latin and Devanagari recognizers are created for each scan.
audit_findings.correction: Reuse recognizers for the service lifetime and close them in onDestroy.
Use relevant events to invalidate/refresh cached UI state when live updates are required.

audit_findings.finding: No /home endpoint exists in current source.
audit_findings.correction: Do not list Home as a bridge endpoint until implemented and tested.

audit_findings.finding: APK artifact timestamp does not prove installed service provenance.
audit_findings.correction: Install the exact APK, disable/re-enable Accessibility Service, then verify /action/status and fresh /scan.

corrected_truth_table./tap: Implemented; current runtime completion requires retest.
corrected_truth_table./swipe: Implemented; current runtime completion requires retest.
corrected_truth_table./type: Implemented via focused editable AccessibilityNodeInfo; current runtime effect not independently proven in this audit.

verification_protocol.level_4: Fresh post-action screen proves the intended UI state.
verification_protocol.final_rule: Only level 4 is a fully verified phone action.

confirmed: Current Accessibility architecture and bridge source are present.
Gesture capability and dedicated callback HandlerThread are configured.
UI-tree and OCR screen observation are implemented.
Back implementation exists and was user-confirmed in an earlier test.
Historical native YouTube end-to-end playback was documented.
not_currently_proven: Reliable tap completion in the currently installed runtime.
Reliable swipe completion in the currently installed runtime.
Current APK/service provenance for the historical YouTube PASS.
final_audit_conclusion.next_validation_gate: Install/restart the exact current APK, re-enable Accessibility Service if needed, then run fresh pre-state → action → callback → post-state tests for tap and swipe.
